name: AWS Transcribe
label: AWS Transcribe
description: Official Amazon Transcribe batch jobs (API 2017-10-26) on INPUT input → OUTPUT output. start_job / get_job / list_jobs / delete_job POST https://transcribe.{region}.amazonaws.com/ signed with AWS SigV4 (service transcribe). X-Amz-Target Transcribe.{Action} and Content-Type application/x-amz-json-1.1 are set per operation. listen = streaming ingress (no socket). IAM keys are StudioQuack secrets (access_key_id, secret_access_key, optional session_token). Media is an S3 URI. Docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/APIReference/API_StartTranscriptionJob.html. Terms: https://aws.amazon.com/agreement/. Never log credentials. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. start_job requires TranscriptionJobName + Media (MediaFileUri S3). get_job / delete_job require TranscriptionJobName. list_jobs optional Status / NextToken. listen is ingress. Do not put AWS keys here. Example: {"TranscriptionJobName":"job-1","LanguageCode":"en-US","Media":{"MediaFileUri":"s3://bucket/audio.flac"}}.

schema.label: TranscriptionJobName
schema.description: Job name. Pattern ^[0-9a-zA-Z._-]+, length 1–200. Required for start/get/delete.

schema.label: Media
schema.description: start_job Media object. Required key MediaFileUri (s3://...).

schema.label: LanguageCode
schema.description: e.g. en-US. Omit when IdentifyLanguage / IdentifyMultipleLanguages is true.

schema.label: IdentifyLanguage
schema.description: Optional auto language id on start_job.

schema.label: OutputBucketName
schema.description: Optional S3 bucket for the transcript. Omit to use the Transcribe service bucket.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: list_jobs filter. EXACT: QUEUED | IN_PROGRESS | FAILED | COMPLETED.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (TranscriptionJob JSON). Expect HTTP 403 until SigV4 + X-Amz-Target exist. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official Transcribe verb. EXACT: start_job | get_job | list_jobs | delete_job | listen. Batch ops POST / with X-Amz-Target Transcribe.{Action}. listen = streaming ingress (no socket).

configurationParameters.label: AWS access key ID
configurationParameters.description: IAM access key ID used as the SigV4 credential. StudioQuack secret. Never on INPUT. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: AWS secret access key
configurationParameters.description: IAM secret access key used to sign SigV4. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: AWS session token
configurationParameters.description: Optional STS session token. When set, OfficialApiNode adds x-amz-security-token. Empty for long-lived keys. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Region
configurationParameters.description: AWS region for https://transcribe.{region}.amazonaws.com. Example: us-east-1. Required for SigV4.
